title: Prove matching essential-event Gaussian scale on coordinate axes
body:
The existing essential-event proof established positivity at each fixed separation; PR522 adds a Gaussian upper bound. This candidate supplies the matching lower scale for the actual original determinant-weighted Gaussian law on coordinate axes:

`exp(-C/r^2) <= Q_r^W(essential) <= C' exp(-c/r^2)`.

The scope is fixed `d>=2,L>0`, compact birth/gap ranges with a positive gap floor, and signed coordinate axial directions. Thus `-log(probability)=Theta(r^-2)` at that scope.

The new proof constructs a literal degree-two periodic Fourier template satisfying the exact pins, with a unique global maximum, the required saddle type and RKHS norm `O(1/r)`. A fixed C4 ball of zero-pin perturbations preserves the global event and gives `W_r>=w_*r^2`. Centered conditional variance contraction gives that ball probability at least one half; symmetric Cameron-Martin translation gives its true `exp(-C/r^2)` cost. Dividing by the same full normalizer completes the lower bound. No shrinking-small-ball or marked-law hypothesis is assumed. The explicit template cost is one-sided and is not claimed optimal.

**Stacked on #522**, at exact source head `223293d9d26a7a4158026a4225523e8a683a8794`; #522 remains Draft and is not treated as accepted/default source. This PR adds only eight files in the new frontier packet and its plan. title: Derive Gaussian lifetime exponential tails and sharp axial escape
body:
The lifetime-tail argument previously used a conservative axial condition and imported all-order weighted norm moments. This candidate proves the sharp deterministic condition and derives the needed exponential norm control from the explicit periodized Gaussian source.

- **Sharp escape:** `r ||g''''||_infinity < 24k` gives an axial path ending above birth with minimum at the lower pin. The previous sufficient constant was 3. A quartic proves sharpness and failure at equality for an axial-only conclusion. A separate no-tied-critical-height corollary handles the boundary when the path may leave the axis.
- **Actual Gaussian tilt:** for fixed `d>=2,L>0`, compact birth/gap ranges with positive gap floor, and all orthonormal frames, derive `E_Pr exp(lambda (1+||f||_C4)^2)<=C`. The proof retains posterior drift/correlations, reconstructs the corrected contact-Hessian full-normalizer floor, and divides by that full normalizer once.

These upper bounds need no failure-mark weak law, selection estimate or added uniform-integrability premise.
